name: agent-guards
description: Deterministic security checks for coding agents, from the repo that publishes the six agent-guards MCP servers.

plugins.name: agent-guards
plugins.description: Deterministic security checks in Claude Code's path: package names before an install, secrets and code rules on what was just written, injection and Unicode-obfuscation patterns in fetched pages. No network call in any hook, no model in any check.
